_說明: 英雄資料的人工翻譯表。俄文原文由 map_heroes.py 從 UD_v3.81 地圖直接讀出，
這裡只放中文／英文對照。vocab 是封閉詞彙（強度等級、後期潛力、定位），
names 是英雄名稱，desc 是一句話說明。
Emoo 在地圖裡沒有覆寫名稱（沿用原版單位），所以名稱是手動補的；第三個元素是俄文，取自單位的 utip「Жрица Луны」。
Nbrn / Ekee / Nsjs / H03I 這 4 位不在隨機英雄池裡（只能手動挑），全是 T3+。
skins = 英雄皮膚名稱。41 個皮膚分屬 28 位英雄，其中 10 個預設關閉（稀有／限定）。

Edem: A melee assassin that is easy to learn.
H00N: 高效的射手，擊殺高危目標可以額外累積自身威力。
An effective shooter that gains extra power from killing high-value targets.
H01G: 遠程英雄，擅長消滅單一目標，可短時間大幅提高攻擊速度。
A ranged hero who excels at deleting single targets and can briefly spike her attack speed.
N00Z: 遠程英雄，能降低單體防禦並擾亂敵方隊伍。
A ranged hero who lowers single-target armour and sows confusion in enemy ranks.
N010: 危險的近戰英雄，對單一目標效率極高；學習高階天賦後更強。
A dangerous melee hero, highly effective against single targets and stronger with advanced talents.
N01P: 背包格數受限，但攻擊速度極高，能短暫變身。
Limited inventory, but extremely high attack speed and a temporary transformation.
N02E: 近戰刺客，需要按順序連續施放技能才能發揮。
A melee assassin who needs her abilities cast in the right order to perform.
O015: 能把傷害集中在單一目標，並製造巫毒娃娃快速處理敵人。
Concentrates damage on single targets and creates voodoo dolls to delete enemies quickly.
Emoo: 刺客型英雄，物理與魔法傷害兼具，泛用性高。
An assassin dealing physical and magical damage in equal measure - very versatile.
H024: 可以偷取敵方英雄的道具並在戰鬥中賺取金幣，但戰鬥力偏弱。
Steals items from enemy heroes and earns gold in combat, but is weak in a straight fight.
N05T: 著魔的刺客，攻擊與移動速度都很高，能累積力量。
An obsessed assassin with high attack and movement speed who builds up power.
O01O: 近戰英雄，普攻與技能傷害相當平衡。
A melee hero with damage balanced evenly between attacks and abilities.
U00Q: 侵略性的遠程英雄，能擾亂敵方隊伍並高效清場。
An aggressive ranged hero who disrupts enemy formations and clears efficiently.
U01D: 近戰英雄，普攻、技能與流血效果都能吸血，並有多種減益。
A melee hero with lifesteal from attacks, abilities and bleed, plus several debuffs.
N06B: 靈活的盜匪，能非法增加收入、強化建築並偷取金幣。
A nimble bandit who boosts income illicitly, upgrades buildings and steals gold.
Nngs: 近戰刺客，靠擊殺敵方英雄來增強自己的技能威力。
A melee assassin who grows her ability power by killing enemy heroes.
Npbm: 結實的近戰英雄，強化路線很多，部分技能有獨立運作方式。
A sturdy melee hero with many upgrade paths; some abilities work independently.
E00S: 制裁與律法的化身。最強的近戰英雄之一，能把攻速拉到極限。
The embodiment of retribution and law - one of the strongest melee heroes, able to reach extreme attack speed.
Hmgd: 強力的近戰單挑者。沒有輔助道具時對群戰無力，但單體極強。
A powerful melee duellist. Helpless against groups without support items, but devastating one-on-one.
E00A: 遠程法師，完全依賴召喚出來的部隊作戰。
A ranged mage who relies entirely on summoned troops.
H00O: 圍繞防禦塔與兵營運作的英雄。
A hero built around guard towers and barracks.
H00Q: 遠程英雄，用組合技能打出高額魔法傷害。
A ranged hero who deals high magic damage through ability combos.
H00X: 遠程英雄，單體治療能力極強，還能改造道具。
A ranged hero with very strong single-target healing who can also transmute items.
H012: 遠程英雄，主要靠魔法傷害，能給自己或隊友套上秘法護盾。
A ranged hero built on magic damage, able to shield himself or allies.
H01E: 遠程英雄，具備範圍治療，並能削弱敵方部隊。
A ranged hero with area healing who can weaken enemy formations.
N01K: 近戰英雄，用地雷與臨時砲塔控場，還能修理建築。
A melee hero who controls the field with mines and temporary towers, and can repair buildings.
E00O: 全能法師，能輸出、控場、治療隊友並召喚援軍。
An all-round mage who deals damage, disables enemies, heals allies and summons help.
Hamg: 戰鬥法師，只有攻擊性法術，專精於「點燃」狀態。
A battle mage with purely offensive spells, specialising in the Ignite status.
N03R: 強力法師，但只能攜帶 4 件道具。可召喚火靈，另有獨立資源。
A strong mage limited to 4 items. Summons a fire spirit and runs on a separate resource.
N03S: 無情的法師，對敵方集群造成巨量傷害，但非常吃法力。
A merciless mage who devastates enemy clusters but is extremely mana-hungry.
U011: 近戰法師，能用自己的法力吸收傷害。
A melee mage who absorbs damage with his own mana.
H02Y: 特殊的輔助英雄，不直接參戰，專門強化隊友。
A unique support hero who never fights directly, existing to buff allies.
H03Z: 強力法師，用組合技能打出巨量傷害。
A powerful mage who deals enormous damage through ability combos.
Naka: 能提升友方建築防禦並為其套上魔法屏障，具備獨特機制。
Raises the armour of friendly buildings and shields them with a magic barrier.
H01Y: 最強的戰鬥法師，技能組合複雜而全面。
The strongest battle mage, with complex and comprehensive abilities.
Nalc: 強大的遠程法師，擁有自己的累積型資源來強化技能。
A mighty ranged mage with his own accumulating resource that empowers his abilities.
H00P: 高效的戰士，能暈眩單體並造成範圍傷害，還能複製神器。
An effective fighter who stuns single targets, deals area damage, and can duplicate an artifact.
H00Z: 近戰英雄，積極治療隊友可以累積增益。
A melee hero who stacks bonuses by actively healing allies.
H01C: 攻擊距離極遠，能造成小範圍傷害，但行動遲緩。
Extremely long attack range with small-area damage, but slow to move.
H01D: 近戰英雄，能定期召喚「聯盟」部隊，技能圍繞召喚設計。
A melee hero who regularly summons Alliance troops; his abilities revolve around them.
Hapm: 近戰英雄，可走多種路線。裝備類乘數對他影響特別大。
A melee hero with several viable roles - modifier items affect him unusually strongly.
N017: 堅韌的近戰英雄，能削弱敵人，但自己也容易吃到負面效果。
A tough melee hero who weakens enemies but is himself vulnerable to debuffs.
N01V: 獨立性強的近戰英雄，不需要隊友照顧也能撐住。
A self-sufficient melee hero who can hold his own without help.
N027: 兇猛的近戰戰士，靠生產糧食來累積生命值上限。
A fearsome melee warrior who grows his health pool by producing food.
H01H: 圍繞防禦塔運作的英雄，可以躲進碉堡。
A hero built around guard towers who can hide inside a bunker.
H025: 近戰英雄，受到的狀態傷害較低，並具備多種手段。
A melee hero who takes reduced damage from statuses and has many tools.
N02K: 背包格數受限，但靠防禦類型獲得極高生存力。
Limited inventory, but extremely durable thanks to his armour type.
O01M: 極為堅固的坦克，專門吸收大量傷害；死亡會受到懲罰。
An extremely tough tank built to soak damage, but penalised heavily on death.
O022: 莽撞的近戰英雄，在戰鬥狂熱中能打出大量傷害。
A reckless melee hero who deals heavy damage once his battle frenzy builds.
H02L: 英勇的戰士，能擋下敵軍推進、突入後排並保護隊友。
A valiant warrior who holds back the enemy advance, dives the back line and protects allies.
Hmkg: 機動性高的近戰英雄，能衝進戰場中心並承受大量傷害。
A mobile melee hero who charges into the thick of battle and absorbs a lot of damage.
Ocbh: 強力的近戰英雄，能累積力量來釋放強大技能。
A powerful melee hero who accumulates strength to unleash mighty abilities.
H01F: 戰鬥力偏低，但能治療隊友並提升隊友的技能強度。
Low combat potential, but heals allies and raises their spell power.
Nbrn: 遠程英雄，能對單體與集群穩定輸出魔法傷害，並可持續累積敏捷。
A ranged hero with steady magic damage against both single targets and packs, who accumulates Agility over time.
Ekee: 沒有普通攻擊的法師，靠屏障控場並殲滅大量敵人，非常吃法力。
A sorceress with no attack at all, controlling the field with barriers and wiping large packs - very mana-hungry.
Nsjs: 結實的遠程英雄，防禦類型為「強化」，側翼砲塔會自動射擊前方敵人，可累積點燃強化。
A sturdy ranged hero with Fortified armour and side turrets that fire on their own, stacking burn amplification.
H03I: 結實的遠程英雄，回復能力優秀，每次升級都有額外加成；滿等之後仍能繼續成長。
A sturdy ranged hero with strong regeneration and extra bonuses per level - and it keeps growing past max level.
